facts.name: Intercontinental Exchange
sentences: Intercontinental Exchange's shares moved 5% or more on 2 of the last 252 sessions.
The last move at least this big in the same direction was on 22 October 2026, when the stock rose 3.9%.
The stock is down 3.7% this year, and at $155.96 it sits 10.9% below its 52-week closing high of $175.10 from 26 January 2026.
$1,000 invested in Intercontinental Exchange five years ago would be worth $1,151 today.
